name: Seishin Osen
source:
Satoshi lives with his wife and daughter. It just looks peaceful outwardly, but it is actually not. There aren't any conversations at all. But one day, his wife and daughter suddenly disappear and Satoshi remembers what that man said, "I'll rob you of everything...." Where are his wife and daughter now? Will Satoshi get them back...?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090727070605/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012665]ErogeShop[/url]]
